title: Tirith: A security hook for your shell, It analyzes every command before you hit enter

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Look at these two URLs. They look identical, right? Wrong. One uses a cerillic eye and downloads malware. The other is safe. Your browser would catch this, but your terminal runs it blindly. Meet Tyth, a security hook for your shell. It analyzes every command before you hit enter. It detects homograph attacks and malicious pipeto-shell payloads instantly. Zero lag. ensures that the code you see is actually the code you
